S1 — BLOCKING: the declared radius family is neither projected nor fully reported.
Invariant/authority: owning bead DESIGN A1 explicitly includes N-foot radius / emanation and requires the full population to be projected or reported with a source-backed reason; its EVIDENCE requires independent population coverage. ADR 0020 preserves these bounded source-projection obligations.
Location: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/mechanicsProjections.ts:877 and :912; packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/spellAreaProjection.test.ts:18.
Concrete scenario: spell:spike-growth (vendored PDF p.182) defines the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range; spell:sunburst (p.184) defines a 60-foot radius centered on a chosen point within range. Both return undefined and appear in neither the test population nor REVIEWED_UNPROJECTED because the recognition regex only accepts the hyphenated -foot-radius token, and parsing has no bare-radius branch. spell:holy-aura (p.155) defines a 30-foot radius around the caster and is also silently absent; description projection only emits point-within-range, despite A1 authorizing printed self/creature/object anchors.
Sibling analysis: searched all spell descriptions independently for radius, radius-of, cylinders, cubes, cones, hemispheres and line dimensions. Further descriptions absent from the narrow population are animate-objects, branding-smite, call-lightning, dancing-lights, fire-shield, flame-blade, flaming-sphere, light, plant-growth, produce-flame and storm-of-vengeance. These require clause-level dispositions, not blanket projection: e.g. Animate Objects is a senses radius, Plant Growth has alternative modes, and Call Lightning has different cloud/strike points. Holy Aura also contains a secondary light radius; this is not a reason to ignore its defining aura sentence.
Consequence/boundary: the agreed projection-loss class remains open while the population gate reports success. This is a Lane A acceptance defect, not a request for universal deterministic spell support.
Required closure: enumerate the full authorized printed-dimension family independently; project unambiguous supported area/anchor clauses such as Spike Growth and Sunburst; handle authorized printed anchors; give source-backed reasons for genuine non-effect dimensions, alternatives or unsupported single-field representations. Regenerate affected pack/inventory and reconcile registry/handoff claims.
Permanent evidence: generalized membership and phrase-to-projection invariant, with source-grounded representative bare-radius/self-origin cases; proportionate because one omitted grammatical family defeats the advertised bounded population check. Repair is MATERIAL (changes parser admission, emitted membership and potentially origin behavior); next state requires fresh full review at the repaired head. Owner: eshyra-o9bd.19.4.1.

S2 — BLOCKING: a subordinate dimension vetoes an otherwise explicit effect-area definition.
Invariant/authority: owning bead DESIGN A1 says to project the sentence defining the spell's effect area and distinguish dimensions describing something else. The permitted exclusion is not an arbitrary all-dimension-sentences-must-agree rule. Importer protocol forbids adjusting evidence to preserve incorrect output.
Location: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/mechanicsProjections.ts:947 and :954; packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/spellAreaProjection.test.ts:78.
Concrete scenario: spell:web (vendored PDF p.192; records.json:180582) first conjures webbing at a chosen point within range and explicitly says the webs fill a 20-foot cube from that point. Later, any 5-foot cube exposed to fire burns away. The parser requires every shape-bearing sentence to contain point and agree, so that burning-subvolume sentence returns undefined; REVIEWED_UNPROJECTED then ratifies the parser's failure. Web has a source-defined 20-foot cube with the exact printed point anchor A1 requires.
Sibling analysis: inspected every declared exclusion and multi-dimension spell. Object/image bounds (Creation/Fabricate/image spells) remain legitimate exclusions; Meteor Swarm has genuinely multiple origins; mode alternatives need truthful dispositions. Freezing Sphere already retains its main sphere despite a secondary 30-feet-square water effect, while Holy Aura's primary/secondary radii will exercise the same distinction once S1's population is repaired. Varying subordinate dimensions or their order must not change an identified primary area; genuinely competing effect areas must remain fail closed.
Consequence/boundary: Web's known point-origin area stays absent from the discovery projection and the reviewed list describes the implementation's rejection rather than a source-semantic conflict.
Required closure: distinguish the defining area clause from subordinate dimensions; emit Web's source-backed cube {shape:cube,size:20,unit:foot,origin:point-within-range}; remove the invalid exclusion and preserve actual ambiguous/multi-origin boundaries. Regenerate and reconcile repair reasoning.
Permanent evidence: generalized invariant that an identified main area survives non-defining dimension clauses, plus an exact source-backed Web regression preserving its 20-foot effect cube versus 5-foot burning subvolume. This small evidence burden directly protects the accepted defect class. Repair is MATERIAL (changes sentence selection/admission and generated output); next state requires fresh full review. Owner: eshyra-o9bd.19.4.1.

S3 — BLOCKING: the required generalized source-matching evidence accepts incorrect projections.
Invariant/authority: owning bead EVIDENCE explicitly requires every typed population member's shape/size/origin to match the defining phrase. Review policy Proof mechanisms are implementation requires evidence to distinguish relevant bad states from good states.
Location: packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/spellAreaProjection.test.ts:105, especially :114-124.
Concrete scenario: ran this actual committed assertion callback against the real pack in memory. It passes unchanged; it also passes after changing Moonbeam's origin to self, and separately after swapping its radius/height to size:40,height:5. PDF p.166 defines a 5-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Both mutants are schema-valid and outside the few exact area examples. The test merely finds shape/numbers anywhere in description plus range, checks allowed-origin membership, and checks that any point word exists only for point-within-range.
Sibling analysis: all non-exact population members share this weakness; every non-square cylinder (Flame Strike, Ice Storm, Magic Circle, Moonbeam, Reverse Gravity) supplies both numbers, and choosing any allowed non-point origin avoids origin checking. Optional height/width omission also bypasses comparison. The membership regex additionally duplicates the production regex verbatim, producing the shared S1 blind spot. Existing exact Fireball/Cloudkill/Sleet Storm cases do not cover this generalized boundary.
Required closure: strengthen the existing population evidence to independently identify the defining source phrase/anchor and compare the complete supported projection, including radius versus height/length versus width and referenced point versus self/creature/object. Preserve justified exception review. Reject the demonstrated incorrect Moonbeam states without adding a separate proof platform or per-record test explosion.
Permanent evidence: a generalized phrase-to-projection invariant rather than dozens of exact reproducers; proportionate to the explicitly authorized evidence and the low cost of comparing this bounded spell population. Repair is NON-MATERIAL if confined to strengthening tests; implementation changes uncovered by it are material and require fresh full review. Owner: eshyra-o9bd.19.4.1.

NOT A FINDING: requiring geometry/target execution or whole-spell deterministic closure here — no requirement; Lane A DESIGN and ADR 0020 reserve interpretation/capability execution to their existing owners.
NOT A FINDING: inventing point anchors for within-range-only cubes or forcing ambiguous multi-origin/mode spells into one area field — no requirement; retain truthful source-backed exclusions.
NOT A FINDING: demanding Eldritch Blast base-count projection without represented character-level beam scaling — no requirement; A2 explicitly permits leaving it reported.
